name: East Buttress
overview: Ten pitches of steady cracks up a bold, steep line on the Aiguille. The free version tracks the original line closely, apart from a more direct start of three pitches replacing the 1978 route's first two. A wide crack system splits the lower buttress; the money pitch (P8, 5.10) is a perfect hand crack that pinches to ring locks. After P6 comes the bivy ledge the first ascent party slept on. Walk off.
fa: FA Werner Landry and Kenny Cook (5.10 A2, 1978); FFA C.S. and James Holland (5.10+, 2023)
